registered_scope: Resource lifecycle, approved action prerequisites and evidence-responsibility admission in the default native workflow; one new complex dual-platform component PR, same naturally authored initial production bytes in two repair arms.
independent_probes: Neutral tasks and expected dispositions are sealed before their verifier adapter is written. Raw failures, source identities and environment failures remain. Synthetic protocol evidence is never reported as native execution. Generic changes are made before the treatment release and before business design.
barriers: Complete independent small-task validation and record native/environment limits before freezing both tool bundles and this method.

Fresh independent design context defines public requirements, native-unit expectations, source-only style/bridge duties and hidden input/environment; independent design approval before implementation.
A fresh author receives only public requirements, pinned stock project APIs and compile-only access. Seal one natural dual-platform initial source before any business render.

Copy exact initial production bytes to two anonymous arm workspaces; verify byte identity before per-arm D0 acquisition. Each arm uses its frozen default tool chain; D0 evidence is collected independently and counted in that arm's cost.
Both final production sources, self claims and bound original source/image reviews must close before hidden acquisition or any independent final quality judgment.

Independent reviewers receive anonymous immutable source/native/image bundles and the public+hidden contract, without treatment mapping or self claims. Seal original judgments and common-cause matching before reveal.

arms.control: Frozen complete v11 skill/controller/native adapters. No retroactive guard/resource behavior is backported. An external safety envelope measures its files/devices and eventually cleans only study-owned resources.
arms.managed: Frozen new default entry: owned scratch budgets/leases/recovery, native action dependency/predicate checks, typed responsibility/subject preflight and source-review admission. No opt-in selector/state list supplied by the repair author.

quality.unit: Independent genuine defect common cause; atomic failed rows and repeated states are not independent bugs.
quality.final_miss: Confirmed initial product causes still present in each final PR / confirmed initial product causes. With a zero denominator report N/A; no injected defects to obtain a denominator.
quality.regression: Confirmed new product causes introduced after the shared initial source; collector/host/oracle failures and unresolved attribution stay separate.
quality.delivery: All mandatory current-source public native/image/source duties and independent public+hidden quality obligations closed, with no confirmed residual/regression or unresolved mandatory evidence. A native CLI exit 0 or typed declaration is insufficient.
quality.unknown: Retain all required unknowns, blocked prerequisites and unsupported responsibilities in denominators. No deleting requirements, threshold relaxation, stale-frame substitution or retrospective detection credit.
quality.attribution: Separate implementation-independent shared host/SDK fixes from new tool benefit. Any post-release tool change requires an explicit amendment, preserving old results and invalidating unqualified primary treatment claims.

cost.development_endpoint: Actual initial author dispatch to each arm's full public final self-review/source closure; report authoring, D0, repair, native commands, source/image review and wait/barrier intervals separately.
cost.complete_delivery_endpoint: Also report mandatory hidden acquisition and independent acceptance closure; grading/design/research/publication overhead is explicitly separated. Unsuccessful endpoints remain costs, not successful-delivery savings.
cost.disk: Identical external sampler for both arms records allocated bytes in each arm's workspace, build cache, evidence output and owned simulator data. Report sampling interval, observed peak (a lower bound on a transient peak), post-final residual, fixed shared preparation and whole-study peak separately. APFS shared blocks and shared SDK/Gradle caches are not represented as exact physical per-arm usage.
cost.successful_delivery_cost: Only accepted PRs contribute successful-delivery costs. Zero accepted PRs means N/A. One paired task is descriptive evidence, not population significance.

cleanup: Before disposal, seal and verify production source capsules, all original plans/receipts/images/reviews, failed command logs, resource journals, metrics and publication reference closure. Reclaim only journaled study-owned devices and positively owned scratch/workspace directories. Retain evidence, main Git history, user devices and shared SDK caches. Record actual cleanup outcomes and leftovers.
